meaning: Certifies the price of the connection and the limits of the necessary root: the seven-clause omission matrix and a non-vacuity witness; a model with two necessary actual roots in which three named route premises fail with no bridge; a first-being derivation with no necessity premise and a model with a contingent maximum; world-relativity of rootness; and a beginning law that does not give the closing premise. It tests three route premises only.
